info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Directory API
info.description: The Document Directory API enables users to access a comprehensive repository of banking documents, facilitating easy retrieval of essential documents such as account statements, transaction records, and loan agreements. This API allows financial institutions and developers to integrate document management capabilities into their applications, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include banking applications, third-party financial services, and compliance systems that require access to historical and current documentation. Utilizing this API can streamline document access workflows and improve customer engagement.

get.description: Fetches the list of documents available in the document directory, providing insight into the contents and structure of the directory.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the document directory. It must be formatted as JSON, adhering to the specified schema to ensure correct data structure and validation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of document directories.

GetDocumentDirectoryRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation in the document directory API.

GetDocumentDirectoryResponse_200.title: Document Directory Response

items.description: A list of documents in the directory.

pagination.description: Pagination details for the document list.

sort.description: Current sort order applied to the document list.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetDocumentDirectoryResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for retrieving a document directory.

Document.title: Document

documentType.description: The type of document, e.g., report, invoice.

retentionClass.description: The retention policy associated with the document.

ownerId.description: The identifier of the owner of the document.

fileName.description: The name of the document file.

mediaType.description: The media type of the document, e.g., application/pdf.

checksumSha256.description: The SHA-256 checksum of the document to ensure integrity.

Document.description: Schema representing a single document in the system.
